import torch, math, time
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
dev='cuda'
def gen(B,C,H,W):
    g = torch.Generator(device=dev); g.manual_seed(1234)
    r = lambda *s: torch.randn(*s, device=dev, generator=g)
    return dict(x=r(B,C,H,W), dw=r(C,1,7,7), dwb=r(C), lnw=r(C), lnb=r(C), w1=r(4*C,C), b1=r(4*C),
                gw=r(1,1,1,4*C), gb=r(1,1,1,4*C), w2=r(C,4*C), b2=r(C))

def rnd_tf32(a):
    v = a.float().contiguous()
    b = v.view(torch.int32)
    b = (b + 0x1000) & ~0x1FFF
    return b.view(torch.float32).double()
def mm_exact(a,w): return a.double() @ w.double().T
def mm_tf32(a,w): return rnd_tf32(a) @ rnd_tf32(w).T
def mm_fp16x3(a,w):
    ah = a.half().double(); al = (a.double()-ah).half().double()
    wh = w.half().double(); wl = (w.double()-wh).half().double()
    return ah@wh.T + ah@wl.T + al@wh.T
def mm_fp16x2(a,w):   # a split, w single fp16 (should fail)
    ah = a.half().double(); al = (a.double()-ah).half().double()
    wh = w.half().double()
    return ah@wh.T + al@wh.T
def mm_bf16x3(a,w):  # 3-way split both, 6 products (drop 3 smallest)
    a=a.double(); w=w.double()
    a1=a.bfloat16().double(); a2=(a-a1).bfloat16().double(); a3=(a-a1-a2).bfloat16().double()
    w1=w.bfloat16().double(); w2=(w-w1).bfloat16().double(); w3=(w-w1-w2).bfloat16().double()
    return a1@w1.T + a1@w2.T + a2@w1.T + a2@w2.T + a1@w3.T + a3@w1.T

def pipeline(p, dt, mm, eps=1e-6, lneps=1e-6):
    x = p['x'].to(dt)
    B,C,H,W = x.shape
    out = torch.nn.functional.conv2d(x, p['dw'].to(dt), p['dwb'].to(dt), padding=3, groups=C)
    out = out.permute(0,2,3,1)
    out = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(out, (C,), p['lnw'].to(dt), p['lnb'].to(dt), eps=lneps)
    a = out.reshape(-1, C)
    h = mm(a, p['w1']).to(dt).reshape(B,H,W,4*C) + p['b1'].to(dt)
    h = torch.nn.functional.gelu(h)
    gf = torch.linalg.vector_norm(h, ord=2, dim=(1,2), keepdim=True)
    nf = gf / (gf.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    h = p['gw'].to(dt) * (h*nf) + p['gb'].to(dt) + h
    y = mm(h.reshape(-1,4*C), p['w2']).to(dt).reshape(B,H,W,C) + p['b2'].to(dt)
    y = y.permute(0,3,1,2)
    return x + y, h

for (B,C,H,W,atol) in [(2,96,56,56,0.0027),(8,768,7,7,0.0029),(1,160,449,7,0.003),(8,320,32,32,0.0029)]:
    p = gen(B,C,H,W)
    ref32,_ = pipeline(p, torch.float32, lambda a,w: a@w.T)
    ref64,h64 = pipeline(p, torch.float64, mm_exact)
    tol = atol + 1e-5*ref32.abs()
    print(f"\n== {B},{C},{H},{W}  |y| rms {ref32.pow(2).mean().sqrt():.1f} max {ref32.abs().max():.1f}  |h| rms {h64.pow(2).mean().sqrt():.1f} max {h64.abs().max():.1f}  tol median {tol.median():.4f}")
    e = (ref32.double()-ref64).abs()
    print(f"  fp32 torch ref vs fp64: max {e.max():.2e} rms {e.pow(2).mean().sqrt():.2e}  frac>tol {(e>tol).double().mean():.4f}")
    for name, mm in [('tf32',mm_tf32),('fp16x2(w single)',mm_fp16x2),('fp16x3',mm_fp16x3),('bf16x3/6',mm_bf16x3)]:
        y,_ = pipeline(p, torch.float64, mm)
        e = (y - ref32.double()).abs()
        print(f"  {name:18s} vs fp32 ref: max {e.max():.2e} rms {e.pow(2).mean().sqrt():.2e}  frac>tol {(e>tol).double().mean():.4f}")

class Kernel:
    def __init__(self, cubin, name):
        torch.zeros(1, device="cuda")                    # make torch's primary context current
        self.ctx = _ok(driver.cuCtxGetCurrent(), "cuCtxGetCurrent")
        self.module = _ok(driver.cuModuleLoadData(cubin), "cuModuleLoadData")
        self.fn = _ok(driver.cuModuleGetFunction(self.module, name.encode()), "cuModuleGetFunction")
        self.name = name

    def set_smem(self, nbytes):
        """Allow more than 48 KB of dynamic shared memory."""
        attr = driver.CUfunction_attribute.CU_FUNC_ATTRIBUTE_MAX_DYNAMIC_SHARED_SIZE_BYTES
        _ok(driver.cuFuncSetAttribute(self.fn, attr, nbytes), "cuFuncSetAttribute")

    def __call__(self, grid, block, *args, smem=0, stream=None):
        _ok(driver.cuCtxSetCurrent(self.ctx), "cuCtxSetCurrent")   # driver contexts are per thread
        vals, types = [], []
        for a in args:
            if isinstance(a, torch.Tensor):
                vals.append(a.data_ptr()); types.append(ctypes.c_void_p)
            elif isinstance(a, i64):
                vals.append(int(a)); types.append(ctypes.c_int64)
            elif isinstance(a, int):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_int32)
            elif isinstance(a, float):
                vals.append(a); types.append(ctypes.c_float)
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"unsupported launch argument {type(a)}")
        g = tuple(grid) + (1,) * (3 - len(grid))
        b = tuple(block) + (1,) * (3 - len(block))
        s = stream if stream is not None else torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
        _ok(driver.cuLaunchKernel(self.fn, *g, *b, smem, driver.CUstream(s), (tuple(vals), tuple(types)), 0),
            f"cuLaunchKernel({self.name})")

def compile_cubin(src, opts=()):
    """CUDA C++ source -> cubin bytes for sm_100a with NVRTC. Raises with the compile log on error."""
    prog = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcCreateProgram(src.encode(), b"probe.cu", 0, [], []), "nvrtcCreateProgram")
    options = [f"--gpu-architecture={ARCH}".encode(), b"-std=c++17", f"-I{CUDA}/include".encode(),
               *[o.encode() for o in opts]]
    err = nvrtc.nvrtcCompileProgram(prog, len(options), options)[0]
    log_size = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLogSize(prog), "nvrtcGetProgramLogSize")
    log = b" " * log_size
    nvrtc.nvrtcGetProgramLog(prog, log)
    if int(err) != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("NVRTC compile failed:\n" + log.decode(errors="replace"))
    size = _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBINSize(prog), "nvrtcGetCUBINSize")
    cubin = b" " * size
    _ok(nvrtc.nvrtcGetCUBIN(prog, cubin), "nvrtcGetCUBIN")
    return cubin
